Concept bank: the race: the runners, the track and the start

4 of the 85 concepts, of the family “illustrated, style B”, atoms first. Style B, “flat with light”, validated by the author on 22 October 2026: the people, the AI system, island 1.1’s use-case documents, and landmark (b)’s textual data, its domains and the concentration bar; landmark (c)’s absent model, translator, test and balance, and landmark (d)’s benchmark, its stations and the two French models, validated on 23 October 2026. Drawn with world/illustration/ (the look, the equipment, the paper). Each specimen is drawn by its function with the arguments of the calibration sheet he validated, alone, at whole size (a person is 360 units tall), at 1/3 and at 1/20, then its states and variants at 1/2.
